inputs.text:
Cinematic wide shot of two puppies of different breeds playfully tumbling together on a manicured park lawn at dusk — a fluffy Golden Retriever puppy andaˀ a sleek Dalmatian puppy mid-play, one pawing at the other, both caught in a moment of pure joyful chaos. Soft golden-hour light fading into the blue hour, warm amber glow kissing their fur from a low sun angle. Lush green grass with a slight dew shimmer. Surrounding the park, towering modern high-rise buildings rise dramatically into a dusky gradient sky — deep orange at the horizon bleeding into violet and deep blue above, a few early stars barely visible. City lights in the buildings beginning to flicker on, warm yellow window glows scattered across the glass facades. 
Shallow depth of field with puppies in sharp focus, buildings softly bokeh'd but fully present. Cinematic color grade — warm foreground, cool blue-purple sky, rich contrast. Shot on Sony Venice, 35mm anamorphic lens. Photorealistic. Heartwarming and cinematic.
